purpose: Separate the two GE06 constraint-source rows changed together in valid Repair43: the independent shift-constraint source row0 and the anisotropy source row1 used in canonical algebraic elimination. Reproduce frozen Repair43 constraint-family variants, quantify full-active-field and preregistered early-window hotspot responses, and test the operator-predicted row0-only Z21 invariance before any H4 science reclosure.

operator_structure.source_order: six main rows followed by shift constraint source index 6 and anisotropy source index 7
operator_structure.source_shift_row0: Independent checked shift constraint row Cmat[10]+Cmat[11]. Not used in canonical operator evolution or algebraic elimination.
operator_structure.source_anisotropy_row1: Used in the algebraic elimination through Rr[5,7]=1 in Repair07 canonical operator.
operator_structure.prediction: Shift-row0-only direct source correction must leave all reconstructed Z21 states exactly unchanged versus frozen Repair37 PCHIP baseline. Its shift residual may change due only to its right-hand side, while its backward-error denominator is recomputed from the unchanged row contributions and changed source.

unchanged_contract.direct_values: Exact frozen Repair41 saved direct382/direct763 stage values; no interpolation of direct values
unchanged_contract.non_target_and_GE06_main: Frozen Repair37 PCHIP total source, unchanged

correction_definition.shift_row0: Repair41 direct GE06 constraint row0 at each factor-1 stage minus its frozen standalone PCHIP GE06 row0. Keep GE06 row1 and all main rows frozen.
correction_definition.anisotropy_row1: Repair41 direct GE06 constraint row1 at each stage minus its frozen standalone PCHIP GE06 row1. Keep GE06 row0 and all main rows frozen.
correction_definition.both: Sum both constraint row corrections, exactly reproducing Repair43 direct382/direct763 CONSTRAINT_ONLY.
correction_definition.initial_x0: Retain frozen PCHIP source and frozen projected p0.

diagnostic_quantities.full_active_field_closeness: RMS difference between each single-row intervention shift-metric field and frozen Repair43 full two-constraint-row shift-metric field. Determine closer row per direct resolution without dominance percentage threshold.
diagnostic_quantities.state_controls: Row0-only must reproduce frozen baseline Z21 exactly. Report anisotropy-row1-only Z21 response relative L2 and absolute norm.
diagnostic_quantities.norm_controls: Store actual absolute shift residual and actual backward-error denominator per active sample rather than inferring normalized metric solely from source magnitude.

diagnostic_routes.QGE06_SHIFT_ROW0_FIELD_CLOSER_TO_FULL: All implementation gates pass and row0-only is strictly closer to full two-constraint-row shift field on both direct382 and direct763.
diagnostic_routes.QGE06_ANISOTROPY_ROW1_FIELD_CLOSER_TO_FU: All implementation gates pass and row1-only is strictly closer on both direct382 and direct763.
diagnostic_routes.QGE06_MIXED_CONSTRAINT_ROW_SENSITIVITY: All implementation gates pass but resolutions disagree or a tie occurs.
diagnostic_routes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Any frozen parent/reproduction/stage binding, exact row0-only Z21 invariance, p0, active mask or finiteness gate fails.

next_step_rule.if_row0: Freeze diagnostic. Test source-constraint compatibility at the registered early-time m8 hotspot using consistent full-source/fine-parent data and the exact Noether/shift relation, without modifying science thresholds or fitting row0 to the desired residual.
next_step_rule.if_row1: Freeze diagnostic. Trace the anisotropy-source insertion through frozen WY/WR canonical elimination and corresponding independent shift row.
next_step_rule.if_mixed: Freeze diagnostic. Trace both constraint rows jointly and test their algebraic/Noether compatibility; do not declare either erroneous.
